units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:6">Y. Shek. I, 45ᵈ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Zephaniah 3:7">Zeph. III, 7</cite>) <he>כל ה׳ … בהשכמה וכ׳</he> whatever destructive work the Israelites undertook, they did with early rising (eagerly).
Ex. R. 10, end הַשְׁחָתַת הצפרדעים the injury (to their bodies) caused by the frogs (Ps. LXXVIII, 45); a e.—2) (with ref. to Lev. XIX, 27) shaving with a razor.

<cite ref="Nazir 57b:6">Naz. 57ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 35b:11">Kidd. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שישנו בה׳ וכ׳</he> he to whom the law, ‘Thou shalt not destroy’ (Lev. l. c.) applies, is subject to the law, ‘Ye shall not take off all around &c.’, v. <cite ref="E00800"><he>הַקָּפָה</he></cite>. Ib. <he>גילוח שיש בו ה׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00727"><he>גִּילּוּח</he></cite>; a. fr.
